title: Phantom (Prototype) — AI Security Monitoring System
description: Built a centralized security monitoring system with Gateway + Agent architecture for autonomous threat detection and analysis. Features LLM-powered analysis, real-time dashboards, and multiple input interfaces.
details: Designed a Gateway + Agent architecture separating I/O routing from intelligence and analysis layers.
Implemented LLM-powered security analysis with context-aware session memory and structured reporting.
Built multiple input interfaces: HTTP API, CLI, Redis/RabbitMQ queues, file triggers, and WebSocket.
Created a Flask web dashboard with real-time agent reasoning, schedule management, and alert handling.
learnings: Learned how to design autonomous systems with human-in-the-loop safety controls and approval workflows.
Learned the value of sensor-agnostic architectures for extensible monitoring systems.
Learned practical patterns for context management and memory in long-running AI agent sessions.

title: Pi Dev Stack (Prototype) — Raspberry Pi Homelab CLI
description: Developed a self-hosted homelab CLI for Raspberry Pi managing Docker Compose services including AI runtimes, automation, monitoring, networking, and remote access through a single command interface.
details: Built an interactive CLI orchestrating 15+ Docker services including Ollama, n8n, Pi-hole, and Portainer.
Integrated MCP server for AI-assisted homelab inspection and safe operational commands.
Implemented Cloudflare tunnel support for temporary HTTPS access and stable domain routing.
Added backup/restore commands and local state separation for safe git pull operations.
learnings: Learned how to design CLI tools that manage complex multi-service Docker Compose stacks.
Learned practical homelab networking including DNS filtering, tunnel management, and remote access.
Learned to balance developer experience with operational safety in self-hosted infrastructure.

title: Plan + Approve Web-Search AI Agent (CLI)
description: Implemented a stateful AI agent that plans, pauses for approval, and conditionally performs web search. Used LangGraph for interrupt/resume, conversation summarization, memory checkpointing, and structured JSON planning with detailed logging.
details: Built a LangGraph-based agent workflow that creates plans, pauses for approval, and then continues execution safely.
Added interrupt/resume support with checkpoints so long-running sessions keep context across turns.
Implemented structured JSON plans and logging to make each decision traceable during debugging.
Integrated conditional web-search execution so the agent only calls search tools when needed.
learnings: Learned how to design AI-agent flows that stay controllable with explicit approval checkpoints.
Learned to treat observability as a core feature for debugging agent decisions.
Learned practical patterns for resumable workflows and memory handling in multi-step AI systems.

title: Uber Backend (Educational Architecture)
description: Built an educational C++ backend inspired by Uber's architecture using a custom modular framework. Implemented three multithreaded microservices and centralized logging via a Singleton pattern for clarity, maintainability, and observability.
details: Built three microservices for rider requests, driver matching, and trip updates, each running with multithreaded request handling.
Used gRPC and HTTP endpoints with Protobuf contracts to keep service communication structured and easy to extend.
Added Kafka and RabbitMQ integrations to model event-driven workflows for ride state updates and async processing.
Implemented a shared Singleton logger with file and console outputs for better debugging and observability during development.
learnings: Learned how to split a complex backend into smaller services with clear ownership.
Learned practical tradeoffs between synchronous APIs and asynchronous event-driven communication.
Learned that good logging design saves major debugging time in distributed systems.

title: Instagram Clone (Mobile)
description: Built a mobile clone with profile management, image upload/deletion, and post interactions (likes) to demonstrate full-stack mobile workflows.
details: Implemented profile and feed screens with post rendering and user interaction states.
Added create/delete post flows with image handling and backend API integration.
Used Redux for predictable state management across authentication, feed, and profile features.
Connected Node.js and MongoDB backend services to support persistent social interactions.
learnings: Learned to connect frontend interactions to backend persistence with clean API boundaries.
Learned how centralized state management helps keep larger mobile apps predictable.
Learned practical handling of media workflows in social-style applications.

title: eHealth Medical System (University Final Project)
description: Developed a full‑stack web and mobile platform for physiotherapists and clients to manage profiles, appointments, and medical reports with SDLC and unit testing.
details: Built web and mobile interfaces for therapists and clients to manage appointments and medical records.
Implemented role-based flows for profile updates, scheduling, and treatment report tracking.
Integrated Dockerized services and shared APIs to support consistent deployments across environments.
Applied SDLC documentation and unit testing practices as part of the final-year engineering process.
learnings: Learned to coordinate full-stack delivery across multiple clients and user roles.
Learned how SDLC planning and testing improve team alignment and system reliability.
Learned to manage project scope while still delivering both web and mobile features.

title: SLM Platform (Local AI Agent Hub)
description: Built a privacy-first local AI platform that exposes a single OpenAI-compatible API for specialized small language model agents. Designed the system so different task-focused agents can be swapped behind one gateway while keeping workloads on local hardware.
details: Built a FastAPI-based gateway that provides an OpenAI-compatible entry point for chat and model-serving workflows.
Designed the platform around specialized local SLM agents so coding, planning, persona, and tool-use tasks can be routed through one interface.
Added support for local-first deployment, Docker-based setup, and Redis-backed job queue infrastructure for platform operations.
Structured the project to support model fine-tuning, Hugging Face integration, and llama.cpp runtime options for practical on-device AI workflows.
learnings: Learned how to design AI infrastructure that keeps privacy and developer ergonomics aligned.
Learned the value of OpenAI-compatible interfaces for reducing integration friction across different AI backends.
Learned how platform design changes when models, runtimes, and training workflows all need to live under one consistent developer experience.

title: Uber Rider App (Frontend)
description: Designed and developed a rider-facing Flutter app integrated with a modular C++ microservices backend. Implemented JWT-based authentication, real-time ride status tracking, and location updates with maps integration.
details: Designed rider flows for sign-in, ride booking, driver tracking, and trip completion with reusable Flutter widgets.
Integrated secure JWT authentication so user sessions are validated against backend APIs.
Connected real-time ride status updates to keep the UI synchronized with backend trip events.
Added map-based pickup and route views to improve rider visibility and booking accuracy.
learnings: Learned how to design mobile screens that stay responsive while backend data updates in real time.
Learned to connect authentication, API calls, and state management into one stable user flow.
Learned how location features improve product usability when paired with clear UI feedback.

title: C++ Modular Framework
description: Created a high‑performance C++ framework for distributed systems with integrated Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Uber H3 for geospatial indexing. Includes a robust utilities toolkit and a Singleton Logger for console/file logging.
details: Created a reusable C++ foundation layer for building backend services with consistent project structure and shared utilities.
Bundled integrations for Kafka, RabbitMQ, and H3 geospatial indexing to speed up distributed-system prototyping.
Added logging, config helpers, and common utilities so new services can start quickly with less boilerplate.
Packaged dependencies through Conan to keep builds reproducible across development environments.
learnings: Learned how to build reusable internal tooling instead of repeating setup in every project.
Learned that dependency management and build consistency are critical for long-term maintainability.
Learned to design framework pieces that are flexible without becoming over-engineered.

title: WhatsApp UI Clone (Mobile)
description: Replicated the core WhatsApp interface to demonstrate UI/UX implementation and component-based mobile architecture.
details: Recreated key WhatsApp screens including chat list, chat room, and status-like layouts.
Built reusable React Native components to keep styling and behavior consistent across screens.
Focused on spacing, typography, and interaction details to match familiar messaging-app UX patterns.
learnings: Learned to break UI into reusable components that are easier to test and maintain.
Learned how small spacing and typography decisions strongly affect perceived product quality.
Learned to replicate complex app layouts while keeping code structure clean.

title: Employee Management System (University Group Project)
description: Built a centralized web application to streamline monthly payroll processing and automate payslip distribution.
details: Created payroll workflows for employee records, monthly salary calculations, and generated payslips.
Implemented a centralized management UI so administrators can update records from one place.
Added automation support for distributing payslip information with fewer manual steps.
learnings: Learned how to model business workflows where data accuracy and consistency are essential.
Learned team collaboration skills while building shared features in a group project setup.
Learned to turn repetitive manual operations into simple automation paths.

title: CRUD Web Application
description: Created a web app for direct database manipulation through the UI to showcase CRUD operations and real‑time interactions.
details: Implemented full Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations through a simple frontend dashboard.
Connected React frontend forms and tables to Node.js API routes for live data updates.
Used MySQL for persistent storage and query-based record management.
learnings: Learned end-to-end CRUD fundamentals from database schema to frontend interactions.
Learned to validate inputs and handle API errors so data operations stay safe and clear.
Learned to structure simple applications in a way that can scale into larger systems later.
